knowledge:
- key_parameters: tr=Character string giving the name of the file with transcripts of interest (fasta/fa or gtf/gff formats) ;; genome=Name of pre-installed BSgenome data package with full genome sequences (default is "BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38") ;; codStart=Start codon to scan for in findORFs (e.g., "ATG") ;; pLearn=Fraction of ORFs randomly selected for the training set in classifyORFsCandidates (default is 0.75) ;; nTrees=Number of trees to grow in the random forest classifier (default is 500) ;; modelRF=Name of RDS-file to store the classification model (default is NULL) ;; prThr=Probability threshold for the "winning" class of ORFs in predictORF (default is 0) ;; aaSymbol=Argument in translateORFs to switch amino acid symbols from one-letter to three-letter
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing transcriptomic data (normal or cancerous human cells) to identify, classify, and annotate true open reading frames (ORFs) and distinguish them from non-coding pseudo-ORFs.
- pitfalls: If using gtf or gff formats for transcripts, the genome argument must be specified with a pre-installed BSgenome package, otherwise it may fail or use the default human genome ;; Setting nTrees to too small a number in classifyORFsCandidates may prevent input rows from being predicted at least a few times ;; The input file for getSeqORFs and annotateORFs must include the exact transcripts for which the ORFs were identified and listed in the coordinates file

workflows.name: train_orf_classifier
workflows.intent: Train a custom Random Forest classifier to distinguish true ORFs from pseudo-ORFs using known lncRNA and mRNA sequences.
workflows.stages: 1. Load transcript/ORF sequences using loadTrExper ;; 2. Train the Random Forest classifier using classifyORFsCandidates.
workflows.code:
fileORFLncRNAs <- "http://www.sstcenter.com/download/ORFhunteR/NCBI_RefSeq_release_109_GRCh38.p12_ORF_candidates_sequences_lncRNAs.fasta.gz"
ORFLncRNAs <- loadTrExper(tr = fileORFLncRNAs)
fileORFmRNAs <- "http://www.sstcenter.com/download/ORFhunteR/NCBI_RefSeq_release_109_GRCh38.p12_ORFs_true_sequences_mRNAs.fasta.gz"
ORFmRNAs <- loadTrExper(tr = fileORFmRNAs)
N <- 1000
ORFLncRNAs <- ORFLncRNAs[1:N]
ORFmRNAs <- ORFmRNAs[1:N]
clt <- classifyORFsCandidates(ORFLncRNAs = ORFLncRNAs, ORFmRNAs = ORFmRNAs, pLearn = 0.75, nTrees = 500, modelRF = NULL, workDir = NULL, showAccuracy = TRUE)

workflows.name: predict_and_annotate_orfs
workflows.intent: Predict true ORFs in transcripts of interest, extract their sequences, detect premature termination codons, translate them, and perform basic annotation.
workflows.stages: 1. Predict true ORFs using predictORF ;; 2. Extract ORF sequences using getSeqORFs ;; 3. Detect premature termination codons (PTCs) using findPTCs ;; 4. Translate ORFs in silico using translateORFs ;; 5. Annotate identified ORFs using annotateORFs.
workflows.code:
trans  <- system.file("extdata", "Set.trans_sequences.fasta", package = "ORFhunteR")
model <- "http://www.sstcenter.com/download/ORFhunteR/classRFmodel_1.rds"
ORFs <- predictORF(tr = trans, model= model, prThr = 0)
orfs_path <- system.file("extdata", "Set.trans_ORFs.coordinates.txt", package="ORFhunteR")
tr_path <- system.file("extdata", "Set.trans_sequences.fasta", package="ORFhunteR")
seq_orfs <- getSeqORFs(orfs = orfs_path, tr = tr_path, genome="BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38", workDir=NULL)
gtf_path <- system.file("extdata", "Set.trans_sequences.gtf", package="ORFhunteR")
ptcs <- findPTCs(orfs = orfs_path, gtf = gtf_path, workDir = NULL)
seq_orf_path <- system.file("extdata", "Set.trans_ORFs.sequences.fasta", package="ORFhunteR")
prot_seqs <- translateORFs(seqORFs=seq_orf_path)
prts_path <- system.file("extdata", "Set.trans_proteins.sequences.fasta", package="ORFhunteR")
anno_orfs <- annotateORFs(orfs = orfs_path, tr = tr_path, gtf = gtf_path, prts = prts_path, workDir = NULL)
